instruction: From the most recent email in Notes, access the attached Word file, retrieve the third image, and store it as 'extracted.png' in the Pictures directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the latest email in Notes folder, accessing the Word attachment 'lecture-notes.docx' which contains 3 images (rId4: media/image1.png, rId5: media/image2.png, rId6: media/image3.png as verified from cache extraction), extracting the third image, and saving it to Pictures folder as 'extracted.png'. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists at /home/user/Pictures/extracted.png (30%), (2) file is valid PNG format via signature (20%), (3) file size >= 5KB indicating valid image (10%), (4) CRITICAL: SHA256 hash of extracted file matches the third image (image3.png) from the Word document (40%). The getter extracts the reference third image from the Word document and computes hashes for both files to ensure the correct image was extracted.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator DOES verify the third image was extracted via SHA256 hash comparison (image.py:38-52, image.py:74)
Getter extracts reference third image from Word document (tries 'word/media/image3.png' or 3rd by index) and computes SHA256 hash (image.py:59-74)
Metric correctly compares saved file hash vs reference hash - matches get +0.4, mismatches reduce score to 30% (image.py:36-52)
All instruction requirements verified: file path/name (30%), PNG format (20%), size validity (10%), correct image content via hash (40%)
Graceful degradation: if reference hash unavailable, gives partial credit (+0.2) instead of failing completely (image.py:49-52)

PRACTICAL CONCERN: Reference image extraction may fail if Word document is not accessible as a file at evaluation time - getter tries multiple paths (Downloads, /tmp, email folder) but email attachments in Thunderbird may not be readily accessible as standalone files
MINOR ISSUE: Getter attempts to read mbox email file directly (image.py:32) which won't work, but fallback paths may succeed if user opened/saved the attachment
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add postconfig to ensure Word document is saved/accessible: e.g., copy attachment to /tmp before evaluation or ensure document remains in Downloads folder
Consider adding image metadata verification as fallback if hash comparison fails (dimensions, file size ranges specific to third image)
Document assumption that Word document must be accessible at evaluation time, or provide more robust attachment extraction from Thunderbird's email storage
